name: Anaglyph-to-SBS/TAB
summary: ReShade shader that converts a red/cyan anaglyph frame into Side-by-Side or Top-and-Bottom output. Designed for games with native anaglyph output (FEZ, Limbo, etc.) that lack SBS/TAB modes. Game-specific variants handle UI elements rendered outside the anaglyph pass, which generic shaders miss.
compatibility_notes: Input must be a red/cyan anaglyph frame. Generic variants work for most games. Game-specific variants (FEZ, Limbo) handle edge cases where UI or HUD elements are rendered outside the anaglyph pass and would otherwise appear flat.
